title: Multi-window canvas world
blurb: Drag an interactive HTML card across the bezel between two Chrome windows positioned in screen coordinates, or across a simulated split bezel on one screen. Whichever side holds more than half the card owns the live controls while the other side draws the protruding edge.
question: Can a single live HTML card straddle the bezel between two separate Chrome windows positioned in screen coordinates, stay interactive on whichever side owns authority, and clip cleanly at the canvas edge?
result: Two windows share world coordinates over BroadcastChannel and hand interactive authority across the 50% line. A simulated split-bezel mode runs the same projection and edge clipping inside one page for phones and single screens.
